observations.note: Selected upstream cases pass on every target; not exhaustive conformance.
Empty needle returns NULL for both empty and nonempty haystacks; required result is the haystack pointer.

Valid base-16 input 0xz consumes no character instead of consuming the initial zero. Classify this separately from the invalid-base host divergence. Native-only behavior is not executed by this mixed test.
Valid percent-i integer conversions do not recognize octal/hexadecimal prefixes. Additional failures need individual reduction and standards review.
fprintf returns zero for a successful 13-byte write. A single ungetc after an unsuccessful scanset conversion fails; reduce the stream-state case before designing a fix.
Selected upstream tests pass on all targets. The native floating test is blocked by its snprintf dependency.

next_batches: Reduce proven string/numeric/stdio failures into independent cases before changing implementations.

Prioritize self-contained missing string and integer APIs; inspect macro and existing BSD equivalents first.
Audit filesystem and time wrappers against actual kernel capabilities before promising POSIX semantics.
Extend the initial inventory with math, locale, header constants/types and omitted C/POSIX interfaces.
